# People of Enderal
| Name | Role | Current goal |
|---|---|---|
| Mara Venn | Warden gatekeeper | Maintain passage and account honestly |
| Tovin Pell | Miller, Compact member | Preserve food before frost |
| Hessa Marr | Salt supplier | Collect debts and maintain a trade partner |
| Piers Lowell | Warden toll clerk, Brackenford | Hide an unrecorded timber advance before the audit |

## Mara Venn
Practical veteran, guard stat block if needed; folds paper precisely; says “on the record” when nervous. Wants a sound bridge and fair accounting; fears being blamed for missing funds. Secret: noticed the two versions of the rate differ but hasn't seen the original. Loyal to the Wardens, not blind to wrongdoing. At the gate through dusk. Careful, fair, slow to accuse. Knows Tovin from childhood; owes Hessa for a winter delivery, already repaid.

## Tovin Pell
Miller, commoner if needed; flour on dark sleeves, tells dry jokes. Needs salt for communal stores; limited cash and a family to feed. Secret: pledged next week's mill income to a sick neighbour's medicine, explaining limited cash; not a betrayal. Millers' Compact. At mill by day, gate today looking for cargo. Principled but pressed. Mara once saved his brother; Hessa has supplied him at fair prices.

## Hessa Marr
Salt factor, commoner if needed; concise, keeps meticulous accounts. Wants reliable long-term customers; fears another unpaid winter. Sold Elbane four sacks on 20 silver credit due in 15 days. In the western salt town, not present. Knows Mara as a reliable debtor and Tovin as a regular customer.

Nella Reed is a player character, not an NPC; her player decides her actions.

## Bera Holt
Wool merchant in Brackenford market, practical and attentive; sells cloth, felt and blankets. At her stall under an awning as dusk approaches. Met the couple; no offer or sale yet.

## Dera Voss
Runs the western salt-town cooperage, marked by a painted barrel; usually there during the day. Bera says she ordered mended blankets for her workers. The couple have not met her.

## Meren Vale
Saltmere baker whose shop is by the market well. Hessa says she was looking for flour this week. The couple have not met her.
